prompts.mouths-front.png: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: transparent painted mouth sprite atlas for a 2D anime avatar. Image 1 is the ORIGINAL Luna character identity/style reference only. Match her mouth exactly in spirit: delicate thin muted warm rose-brown SMILE LINE, subtle tiny lower-lip blush accent, elegant understated anime linework. At rest there are NOT two thick outlined lips. NO lipstick, NO glossy highlights, NO inflated lip volume, NO strongly outlined cupid bow, NO realistic fleshy lips, NO teeth drawn individually. Paint ONLY isolated mouths, never nose/face/chin/skin patches. For open mouth: fine outline, warm dark interior and tiny soft tongue/upper tooth band if needed, restrained NOT giant shouting. Keep corners and upper-mouth baseline registered across drawings; jaw opening grows mostly downward. Genuine zero-alpha transparent background, no shadows/haze outside strokes. notes: PNG outputs are preserved unmodified; crop rectangles are integer registration metadata, not bitmap editing or warps.
Each mouth atlas provides 24 distinct source drawings. Viewer-left/right in the prompt are mapped to anatomical Right/Left channels respectively; mirrored head variants swap directional keys once.
All mouth drawings share an upper-lip anchor in fixed 180x180 rectangles and use constant uniform scale per pose. This prevents vertical atlas-layout drift during jaw opening.

The accepted brow atlas uses the standalone browRefinement prompt, not the initial silver/hair-like output. It contains four rows of four drawings, with duplicate neutrals omitted so 13 unique semantic frames are used.
Brow sources are registered against each row's neutral baseline, preserving the actual painted raise/furrow/inner/outer motion.

Up/down mouths reuse front art; diagonal poses reuse three-quarter art. Brows use one canonical painted set with fixed mirroring and per-pose placement/clipping. These are finite 2D approximations, not uniquely redrawn art for every angle.

v3 eye drawings, iris masks, front placement and eye sizes are unchanged. Following live review, yaw/diagonal paired eye centers share a registered eye axis; diagonal raised-mouth anchors moved 22 source pixels down. No third-party character textures were added.
